User.title: User
User.description: Public game profile. Readable by every signed-in school user, so it must never contain a real full name, email or photo.

displayLabel.description: Leaderboard label: school name + surname + 同學, e.g. 救世軍卜維廉中學 林同學

surname.description: Chinese surname only: 1-2 CJK characters, or empty (pending / not shown). Romanised surnames are not allowed.

surnameSource.description: How the surname was set; chosen/manual/none are user decisions and are never overwritten on sign-in

/users/{userId}.description: User documents mapping to their UID.

/users/{userId}/private/surname.description: Owner-only. Chinese surname candidates for the 更改姓氏 picker (options: string[], manual: boolean). No romanised or full names.
